primary_endpoint: At Week 72, proportion achieving ≥1-stage fibrosis improvement without worsening steatohepatitis and/or steatohepatitis resolution without worsening fibrosis, determined by liver biopsy.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 2/32 with EDP-305 1.5 mg, 0/33 with EDP-305 2 mg, and 0/32 with placebo; no deaths.
